summary: First-run comprehensive test of Sonoko (Treesh Games). Backend (9 pytest cases) and frontend (Home, Sonoko, Daily, Sudoku, Uno, Trophies, Leaderboard, mobile 390x844) all pass. API contract matches spec: POST /api/scores returns {id, rank}; GET /api/leaderboard returns list sorted desc with 'id' (not _id); invalid mode -> 422; daily filter by date works. Frontend data-testids all present, deterministic daily seed verified (same discard top across reloads), Sudoku keyboard input + mistake tracking works, Uno auto-starts with 7-card hand and opponents, Trophies has 24 achievement cards + 3 tabs, Leaderboard shows empty state with 4 tabs. Mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow on any game page. Back-home and sound-toggle work.

issues: SONOKO hero wordmark is visually clipped on far right - last 'O' partially off-screen. No horizontal scroll overflow (scrollWidth=390), but letter spacing/font-size could be reduced on <sm breakpoint for cleaner look.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Tighten Home hero 'SONOKO' wordmark on <sm breakpoint so last letter is not visually clipped on 390px wide screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean, async, uses Pydantic validators, no ObjectId leaks (response_model_by_alias=False strips _id -> id). CORS wide open via '*' which is fine for public leaderboard but worth noting.

ResultDialog gates the name input + submit button behind score>0, which hides submission for a 0-score bust. Intended behavior but means losing without placing any card won't surface submission UI (consistent with 'score > 0' check). Not a bug.
No rate limiting on POST /api/scores — leaderboard can be spammed. Minor concern for a public app.
seed_data_creation: Pytest inserted TEST_ prefixed scores (TEST_sonoko, TEST_sudoku, TEST_uno, TEST_daily, TEST_rank_hi, TEST_rank_lo) and cleaned them up in module teardown via direct mongo delete_many on scores collection where name regex ^TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_scores_leaderboard.py (9 tests, all pass). Mongo cleanup is automatic for TEST_ prefix. Frontend data-testid coverage is complete per spec. uno-pass-button is conditional (only renders after drawing a playable card) — not a bug. ResultDialog name-input/submit are gated behind score>0; to exercise score submission in Sonoko you must place at least one correct card (not just bust by drawing). Daily seed is deterministic per date (verified).
